scope: for each projected row of the observation projection, attaches the declared activity coding to each provenance entry and, when declared, the revision entity of the selected correction; an entry without a declared coding stays uncoded and nothing is substituted; the revision relation is carried only on the generating entry of the selected correction, so a correction whose agent is unknown cannot carry it

facts.statement: the activity binding is Example; the page lists candidate code systems and does not limit the codes
Provenance.entity is 0..* and describes an entity used in the activity
facts.marker: An entity used in this activity

facts.statement: entity.role is 1..1 code with the required values revision, quotation, source, instantiates and removal
entity.what is 1..1 Reference(Any), the identity of the entity
revision: an entity used by the activity to produce a new version of that entity (the entity is the older version)
facts.marker: An entity that is used by the activity to produce a new version of that entity

facts.statement: Provenance.target are the references generated or updated by the activity (the newer version)
facts.marker: generated or updated by the activity

facts.statement: between R4 and R5 the entity.role code derivation was removed and instantiates was added
facts.marker: Remove code derivation Add code instantiates

steps: 1 + M_q + 2 per query + 1; M_q is the full observation projection fee and the projection is called once at budget M_q and must use exactly M_q; fees are prepaid, never refunded
answers: results keep the observation row and add coding; certificate is always not_certified and inferred information is always empty
limitations: diagnostic only; activity codes are opaque declarations and their code systems are not checked; only the revision role is produced; the entity identity is the library record reference and hash, not a FHIR resource id; the change reason and the chain beyond the direct predecessors are not carried; no conformance claim
